You press your hand toward the ground beneath your enemy. Roots rise from the soil and cracks, winding around their feet and dragging at their steps.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One visible creature standing on ground within 4 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Roots spring from cracks or soil to catch its feet. They wither immediately after the effect; you are not maintaining a grapple.

Weak
Slowed 1.
Standard
Slowed 2 and pull 1 square toward you.
Strong
Slowed 2, pull 1 square toward you and knock prone.
